subtitle: 一句话，现场造一张卡
description: 输入一句话，应用在本机识别出时间/地点/类型，现场长出一张按场景各不相同的卡，并把确认过的卡与偏好写进本机长期记忆（memory.json）。也可以在导入时绑定一个房间，直接读到那里的最近消息，挑一条就造卡。不依赖任何服务也完整可用。
release_notes: 0.7.1 - the two read switches are ON: read the attached room (matrix.read_messages) and read the assistant's session (octos.session.history). Recognition stays on-device; model.complete is implemented and locally verified but left off, because Rinx grants the capability name `model` while the service is `model.complete` and so refuses it - enable it on a host that serves the model service.
